spans.s: ओल [ōla], a. Wet, damp. -लः An esculent root (शूरण; Mar. सुरण).
The esculent root (Mar. सुरण). ˚आगतः come or received as a hostage (this word occurs once or twice in Viddhaśālabhañjikā).
ओलज् [ōlaj], 1 P. (ओलञ्जति) To cast or throw up.
ओलण्ड् [ōlaṇḍ], 1 P., 1 U. (ओलण्डति, ओलण्डयति, ओलण्डित) To cast or throw upwards, throw up.
